title: If Service State
description: Evaluates a structural pattern against incoming data and conditionally routes it through a nested sub-pipeline. (Runtimes: cpp; IDs: if)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

condition.description: JSON pattern; all key–value pairs must match for the branch to execute

pipeline.description: Ordered list of services to run when the condition is true
